proofIdeas: E1586: independent translation parameters give a six-operation identity; equational cancellation proves bijectivity and both inverse transfers.
E1370: combine E127 and x=y*((S(z*y)*y)*x) by two extra squarings. The joined law forces E127, whose square map is an involution. Recover multiplication by D(D(x,x),y).
E695: the eight-operation identity is E1155 plus the right-unit identity y*e(z)=y. E1155 alone is insufficient. E1710 has the same image among models admitting left division.

Patched subtraction: M(x,y)=-y at x=0 and y-x otherwise. Its division is addition away from the zero row. Large cyclic groups transfer any common image identity to positive addition, then natural addition, then Boolean join. This rules out any single identity for E1278, E1325, and E1387, even on finite carriers.

E1525: for a group automorphism s of order three, M(x,y)=s(x*y^-1*x), D(x,y)=x*(s^2(y))^-1*x. On the free group with three cyclically permuted generators, words beginning and ending in generator zero form a submagma; no boundary cancellations occur and length(D(x,y))=2*length(x)+length(y).

Finite E1525: partial translations of a finite set of word suffixes extend to permutations and separate unequal free-group elements. Three rotated copies preserve s^3=id. Any identity of all finite division images therefore holds in the free-group image, then positive integers under 2*x+y, then nonnegative integers and Boolean join. Join is a finite non-division magma.

The same finite permutation approximations show that no single inverse term recovers M from D across the finite twisted-core family, although each finite D has an inverse term obtained by iterating its bijective rows. This does not negate the uniform forward division term for E1525.

researchOnly.description: Fixed square-cycle partitions through order 10: no cycle length outside 1 or 3 found. Restricted bounded SAT results, not a Lean proof of the general claim.
Conditional square-period queries. Periods 2 and 4 proved by ATP; other queries timed out. Not promoted to catalogue proofs.
Order-nine countermodel refutes the proposed identity (x*x)*y=x*y. All these tables satisfy E1518 and have the displayed fixed diagonal; no assertion of exhaustive unrestricted search.
Cyclic-permutation affine families of dimensions up to 12 did not supply a new image obstruction.
Positive coefficient sums of two cyclic permutation matrices, dimensions up to 8, did not supply a new image obstruction.

E1370 -> E411 cannot be supplied by actual left division: E411 says the fourth power of a row fixes its own index, which is invariant under inverting that row. The existing finite implication counterexample is therefore also a counterexample for this division construction. The broader term-structural arrow remains unknown.

Proposed square-map commutation/period identities: bounded Vampire queries did not establish them. The left-input identity is E375 and is already refuted in the implication catalogue; the saved order-nine example independently demonstrates the failure.
Adding the dual division identity and inverse-square axioms did not prove the conjectured cube period or right-input square commutation.
Restricted searches with one five-cycle and all remaining diagonal points fixed, at orders 14, 15, 20 and 25: all timed out after 120 seconds. These are not nonexistence results.
Thirteen attempts to insert E614 into the six-operation E872 image identity did not prove a one-equation characterization.
Repeating applicable E872 joins with bijective-row hypotheses also did not prove a one-equation characterization.
